passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: 1) Risks related to our company 1.a) We are exposed to health, safety and environmental risks in our operations, which may lead to accidents, significant losses, administrative proceedings and legal liabilities . Activities related to the oil and gas business present high risks, generally because they involve high temperatures and pressures. In particular, deepwater and ultra-deepwater activities, and refining and petrochemicals, performed by us, our subsidiaries or our affiliate companies present several risks, such as oil and product leakage, collapses, aeronautical accidents, fires, and explosions in refineries and exploration and production units, including platforms, ships, pipelines, mines, terminals, laboratories, and losses of containment in dams, among other assets owned or operated by us, our subsidiaries or our affiliate companies. These events can occur due to technical or human failures or natural disasters, among other factors. The occurrence of one of these events, or other related incidents, may result in health impacts on our workforce and/or surrounding communities, fatalities, and environmental damage. They can cause material damage, production losses, financial losses and, in certain circumstances, liability in civil, labor, criminal, environmental and administrative proceedings. As a result, we may incur expenses related to mitigation, recovery and/or compensation for the damages caused. We are also exposed to corporate security risks arising from acts of intentional interference by third parties in our pipelines and nearby areas, especially illegal taps (thefts) of oil and oil products, mainly in the states of São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. Despite our efforts and the actions of public authorities to combat illegal taps, if this interference continues, it may result in accidents of small or large proportions, including leaks or damage to our facilities and to communities near our facilities, which may affect the continuity of our operations and lead to the payment of fines and indemnities to the affected parties, all of which may negatively impact our results. Finally, due to risks such as those mentioned above, we may face difficulties in obtaining or maintaining operating licenses and may suffer damages to our image and reputation. 1.b) Failures in our information technology systems, information security systems (cybersecurity) and telecommunications systems and services can adversely impact our operations and reputation. Our operations are highly dependent on information technology and telecommunications systems and services, as well as the degree of technological protection and the strength of the associated internal controls. Interruptions or malfunctions at these systems and/or their infrastructure, caused by obsolescence, technical failures, deliberate acts, or even arising from geopolitical factors or derived from third-party systems, digital infrastructure and the cloud may harm or even paralyze our business and adversely impact our operations and reputation. These situations may also lead to unforeseen costs for the recovery of information and assets, in addition to the imposition of fines or legal sanctions. A

credit_strengths.text: Gross leverage sits well below the sector median, and net leverage on a cash-and-short-investment basis is roughly half the peer median, placing the issuer in the strongest indicative risk band with substantial headroom to the next boundary.

Operating cash flow covers borrowings far more comfortably than the sector median, and the cash-flow-to-debt ratio improved year on year, reflecting a business that converts crude and refined product sales into cash even as revenue and operating income declined.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows finance debt concentrated abroad, with capital market borrowings the largest single component and the non-current portion dominating the stack, so refinancing depends on continued access to international bond markets rather than domestic bank lines.

Health, safety and environmental exposure is concrete: deepwater and refining operations carry leakage, fire and explosion risk, illegal pipeline taps in Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro threaten continuity, and mitigation, fines and licence loss could absorb cash otherwise available for debt service.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage remains above one but sits below the sector median and fell sharply year on year as operating income weakened, and EBITDA coverage of interest also declined, so debt service headroom is narrowing even though absolute leverage is low.

The current ratio is below one and below both the prior year and the sector median, with current liabilities exceeding current assets, so near-term maturities must be met from operating cash flow rather than balance-sheet liquidity.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, driven by low leverage and strong cash conversion relative to the Energy sector, and the issuer retains considerable room before either leverage or cash-flow thresholds would deteriorate.

My judgement is that credit quality is supported by scale and cash generation but constrained by falling revenue, operating income and margins, thin liquidity, and heavy reliance on international capital markets; the missing capex figure prevents a firm free-cash-flow view and should be obtained before finalising.

credit_strengths.text: 總槓桿遠低於行業中位數，而以現金及短期投資為基礎的淨槓桿約為同業中位數的一半，使發行人處於最強指標性風險區間，並與下一界限之間有相當大的緩衝空間。
營運現金流覆蓋借款的程度遠較行業中位數從容，而現金流對債務比率按年改善，反映該業務即使在收入及經營溢利下降之際，仍能將原油及成品油銷售轉化為現金。

key_risks.text: 債務附註顯示融資債務集中於海外，其中資本市場借款為最大單一組成部分，而非流動部分主導整體債務結構，因此再融資依賴能否持續進入國際債券市場，而非本地銀行額度。
健康、安全及環境風險具體存在：深水及煉油業務帶來洩漏、火災及爆炸風險，聖保羅及里約熱內盧的非法管道接駁威脅營運持續性，而緩解措施、罰款及牌照喪失可能吸納原本可用於償債的現金。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率仍高於一，但低於行業中位數，並隨經營溢利轉弱而按年大幅下降，而EBITDA對利息的覆蓋亦有所下降，因此即使絕對槓桿偏低，償債緩衝空間正在收窄。
流動比率低於一，亦低於上年度及行業中位數，流動負債超過流動資產，因此短期到期債務須以營運現金流而非資產負債表流動性償付。

overall_credit_view.text: 指標性財務風險狀況為極低，主要由於相對能源行業的槓桿偏低及現金轉換強勁，而發行人在槓桿或現金流門檻惡化之前仍保有相當大的空間。
我的判斷是信貸質素受規模及現金生成支持，但受收入、經營溢利及利潤率下降、流動性薄弱，以及對國際資本市場的高度依賴所限制；資本開支數據缺失，無法得出確切的自由現金流觀點，應在最終確定前取得該數據。
